It’s called the American Dream for a reason. There is no Canadian Dream. There is no British Dream. There is no Chinese Dream. The American dream is what makes American exceptionalism possible.

You can travel to Italy, but you’ll never be an Italian.

You can travel to France but you’ll never be a Frenchman.

You can live in Germany but you’ll never be a German.

You can pack your bags and live the rest of your life in China or Japan, but you’ll never be Chinese or Japanese.

Our diversity isn't our strength. Our strength is what *unites* us across that diversity.

It means that we believe that all men are created equal.

It means that we believe our rights are given to us by God, not by our government.

It means that we the people create a government that is accountable to us, rather than the other way around.

It means that our elected representatives write the laws that bind us, not unelected bureaucrats.
